svg.title: Figure 5-3: the risk graph with the rated rows at their leaves
svg.desc: A tree from a start box through severity S1 or S2, frequency F1 or F2 and avoidance P1 or P2 to eight leaves labelled a to e in a teal ramp with e in red; beside each leaf the hazard rows that reach it, the e leaf holding the public-floor row marked excluded and the two d leaves holding the stop-function rows.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 5-3 The ISO 13849-1 risk graph with the rated rows of §5 at their leaves

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paths that at least one row takes are drawn in ink; the leaf gives the required Performance Level of §2.2. The e leaf is the one no bench-build function is designed for: its row is excluded by zone.
